name: electric
note: Rhodes-style tine. No partial series at all: an FM pair at a non-integer 3.37 ratio whose index collapses in 0.35 s, one bell partial at 6.27 f0 from the bar's second mode, and a bark that only appears above about half velocity. Sustain 6.5 s at A4 and far less pitch-dependent than a string, because the bars are individually tuned resonators rather than one scaled string.
